warnings: Door detail sheet with no tabular schedule; recorded as one schedule row per printed mark (precedent: house 155's door/window sheet).
The vent/glass light above the door (0.60 high, across the 4.50 bay) carries no mark of its own; it is kept in the D1 row's note.
The door-head lintel is printed here as 'ทับหลัง ค.ส.ล.ขนาด0.15x0.25ม ฉาบเรียบ เหล็กเสริม Ø9มม4เส้น ปลอก Ø6มม@0.15มม' — wider than the generic lintel on S-06 (0.10 x 0.25); see the S-06 section file.
